recommendations: Consider having evaluate.py explicitly compute and print numeric detection_rate/false_positive_rate/trojan_label_accuracy/inference_latency values (not just pass/fail per requirement) so the declared metrics are directly observable in output rather than only implicitly encoded in SR1-SR3 thresholds.

Consider tightening FR2's case-insensitive matching so that mux/flop entries are also checked against the correct category (e.g., a flop name erroneously listed in suspect_muxes still counts as 'valid instance' under FR2 even though it's the wrong kind of cell); this is a minor scoring nuance not currently discriminated.
